note: How money is rounded and stored (lib/money.js, lib/money-store.js). `rounding` is the platform default rule; `currencies` overrides it per currency code, e.g. {"XYZ": {"rounding": "half-even"}}. Rules: half-up (half away from zero), half-even, half-down, up, down, ceiling, floor. The default below is the engineering default awaiting the owner's written policy (PRODUCTION_READINESS.md PR-016, gate 4). `store` names every persisted money column of the payment spine: each is kept as exact minor units (`<column>_minor`, a 64-bit integer) at the row's `money_scale` in the row's `currency`; the REAL column beside it is a projection written from the minor value and checked against it by the database (docs/money.md). `zero` names the amounts whose column defaults to 0: written as that currency's exact zero when a row does not state them.
